result.topic_en: Draft notes for Riemann's paper on the propagation of plane air waves of finite amplitude: the characteristic equations in r and s, the jump conditions across a compression discontinuity (shock), inequalities between velocity and density jumps, and references to experimental measurements of the speed of sound.
